newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA TO BID FOR 2006 ASIAN GAMES.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA TO BID FOR 2006 ASIAN GAMES.

text.p: Malaysia will bid to host the 2006 Asian Games, Olympic Council of Malaysia (OCM) president Hamzah Abu Samah was quoted as saying by the Bernama news agency on Saturday.
Hamzah said Malaysia, host of the 1998 Commonwealth Games, would officially make its bid at an Asian Games Federation meeting in Bangkok next week.
New Delhi, which organised the Asian Games in 1982, had also indicated its intention of bidding for the 2006 event, Bernama said.
